company.name: Saturn AI
company.shortDescription: Saturn offers AI-based software for financial advisory firms that automates workflows, compliance, investment research, and data management.
company.description: Saturn is an AI technology company that provides financial advice and automates wealth management workflows. Its platform helps financial advisory firms capture and organize client data, automate administrative tasks, generate suitability reports, streamline annual reviews, integrate back-office and advice systems, and manage compliance through file checks and meeting observations. The company also offers CoPlanner tools for advisers and their teams.
